Chapter 753: Chapter 34: Through the Ages (8000 words, please subscribe)_3

Even if Lin Yuan was stronger than her, the gap between them wouldn’t be too large.

But now, having witnessed Lin Yuan effortlessly defeating the Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh-Rank Perfect Lives, as well as the earth-shattering aura he had just released.

At this moment, Xuanyuan Dua’s attitude towards Lin Yuan had changed; it was no longer respect, but reverence, and he almost treated Lin Yuan like a half Supreme Being.

In Xuanyuan Dua’s view, Lin Yuan’s strength in the Two-dimensional World had already far exceeded the pinnacle that normal Eleventh-Rank Life forms could achieve.

“Try to push the Heavenly Gate,” Lin Yuan instructed.

To confirm whether the Heavenly Gate selectively targeted him or not was simple: just let other powerhouses push it as well.

...

“Okay,” Xuanyuan Dua did not doubt and walked to the front of the Heavenly Gate, starting to push it.

“Lord Xueyu, I can’t push it,” Xuanyuan Dua immediately said.

“You can’t push it either?”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

Next,

Lin Yuan randomly selected several other powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes.

He had them all stand in front of the Heavenly Gate and try to push it open.

The result was the same.

They couldn’t move it.

“Try with the natives of the Two-dimensional World.”

After dozens of attempts, Lin Yuan confirmed it wasn’t just him; other powerhouses from the Myriad Clans couldn’t open the Heavenly Gate either, so he decided to let the natives of the Two-dimensional World have a try.

On the mountainside, in a corner at the edge,

Yan Fu, who had just entered the Witch Ancestor Realm, was shivering under the unintentional release of aura by the numerous Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

Even so, Yan Fu felt his journey was absolutely worth it because, here, he witnessed a terrifying battle that had never occurred in past history.

Especially that young man standing in front of the Heavenly Gate; his every move made Yan Fu feel an impulse to worship him like facing the vast universe.

“So strong, so strong.”

“Even if all the Witch Ancestors who have ever existed were combined, they would not compare to a single hair of that powerhouse…” Yan Fu thought, filled with shock.

Suddenly,

a voice came through,

“Come here for a moment,”

Yan Fu paused slightly, instinctively looking towards the mountain summit, to Lin Yuan standing in front of the Heavenly Gate, and found that he was looking at him.

“Me?”

Yan Fu was somewhat incredulous.

Could it be that he, a mere ant, had attracted the attention of a powerhouse like Lin Yuan?

“Okay… okay….” For some reason, besides fear, a tinge of excitement rose in Yan Fu’s heart.

What an honor it was to stand before Lin Yuan, a powerhouse without precedent?

Soon,

under the watchful eyes of many powerhouses from the Myriad Tribes, Yan Fu walked up to Lin Yuan.

“Sir…” Yan Fu bowed deeply to Lin Yuan with the utmost respect.

Even though Lin Yuan’s aura was restrained at the moment, not putting any pressure on Yan Fu, he dared not act recklessly.

The scene reminiscent of the heavens shattering was still circling in his mind; to him, Lin Yuan was an insurmountable mountain, so high that he couldn’t even look up to it.

“Go and push the Heavenly Gate, see if you can open it,” Lin Yuan said tersely.

If Yan Fu, a native Witch of the Two-dimensional World, could open the Heavenly Gate, that would mean that the threshold for Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses and native beings to open the Heavenly Gate was different.

“No problem,” Yan Fu steadied himself and walked to the front of the Heavenly Gate, beginning to push.

A moment later,

“Sir, I can’t open it,” Yan Fu said cautiously.

“I see,” Lin Yuan nodded.

He also came to a conclusion.

There was no difference between the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses and the native lives in terms of opening the Heavenly Gate.

“Is it because of our descent that has caused the difficulty of opening the Heavenly Gate to skyrocket?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

At this point, that was the only explanation that made sense.

“How much has the difficulty of opening the Heavenly Gate skyrocketed? What kind of strength is needed to open it?”

Lin Yuan wondered, feeling for the moment just like the other powerhouses, aimless and uninspired, not knowing what his goal was.

“Hmm?”

“Is there something wrong with my state of mind?”

Lin Yuan immediately realized his change.

The ripples that had constantly affected his state of mind suddenly became calm.

“In just over three hundred years, I have already reached the Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm, and by the time the Heavenly Gate appears again, my strength will far exceed what it is now.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze revealed a sharp determination.

“Even if I can’t make it the next time the Heavenly Gate opens, there will be the time after that, and the time after that. With my extraordinary aptitude, as long as I have time, there are infinite possibilities,” Lin Yuan thought, his state of mind more resolute than ever.

…

As time passed,

the manifested Heavenly Gate began to slowly dissipate.

“The Heavenly Gate is disappearing?”

“It seems that even ‘Blood Rain’ couldn’t enter the Heavenly Gate.”

“Ah… what do we do now? Is there still a need to stay in this Two-dimensional World?”

…

The many powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes felt an exceptional despair.

…

“The Heavenly Gate is going to disappear,”

said Lin Yuan, who was standing in front of it, noticing the changes in the Heavenly Gate.

However, Lin Yuan did not stop it, but quietly watched as the Heavenly Gate fully disappeared.

“Continue cultivating,”

“Set a goal; in ten thousand years, by the next opening of the Heavenly Gate, I must at least have reached the Witch Ancestor Hundredth Realm,” said Lin Yuan decisively turning around and leaving the summit of Heavenly Mountain.

…

What Lin Yuan didn’t know was that he could not open the Heavenly Gate, and it had nothing to do with his own strength.

It was because at the very depths of the Two-dimensional World, a mysterious entity wanted to clearly see his growth rate over the upcoming ten thousand years.

So, the Heavenly Gate that had opened this time was directly locked; no life form could open and enter it.

Even if Lin Yuan possessed tremendous strength, unless he could completely break the restrictions and suppressions of the Two-dimensional World, the Heavenly Gate would remain unopenable.

And completely breaking the Two-dimensional World’s limits and suppressions was something even a Supreme Being could not accomplish.
